title: A host fault reads next: operator, alerts once and pauses its retries
description: GY-4121: three stand-in reviews fail on one missing tool. The operator gets one alert, each item reads next: operator with a one-line host fix, nothing retries, and master status names the cause once with the 3 items it blocks. Clearing it resumes the retries.

steps.name: host cause escalates to the operator
